body:
Both reported `/hive` runs found 19 calculator issues, skipped every issue because PR #228 declared that it closed them, started no solver, and exited successfully. Hive now distinguishes skipped issues from completed work and reports no-work runs with exit 3 and a translated Telegram warning. Completed runs with waiting work exit 4; discovery errors remain failures. The summary includes counts, skip reasons and existing PR links, with per-issue details available through `--verbose`.

The fix covers discovery and worker rechecks across repository/label, organization/user, project and YouTrack paths. It preserves dry-run success, disk-deferral exit 75, dependency scheduling, cleanup safeguards and the existing PR skip policy. It also applies all three deprecated tool-check switches after successful parsing, avoiding the unnecessary greeting seen in both incident logs.

The archived calculator solver logs establish a related scope mismatch: native sub-issue link repair repeatedly attached 18 future implementation issues to a planning PR. The reproduction, workarounds and scope-aware repair proposal were submitted in [calculator #247](https://github.com/link-assistant/calculator/issues/247). Full-hierarchy implementation linkage remains intact; automatic planning-scope selection is the documented follow-up.

Fixes #2685.

### Reproduction and evidence

The [case study](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2685-429d60c8a3fc/docs/case-studies/issue-2685/README.md) includes the requirements matrix, line-numbered timeline, primary-source research, original screenshots, full accessible logs and issue/PR snapshots. The initial reproducer failed 9 of 10 tests before the fix. The final offline fixture exercises the actual hive entry point with the captured 19-issue snapshot and bounded child processes, without paid AI calls or GitHub mutations.

```sh
node --test tests/hive-outcomes-2685.test.mjs
npm test -- --continue-on-failure
```

### Validation

- All 576 default test files passed locally.
- 23 new hive regressions passed, plus existing relation, extracted-module and cleanup checks.
- Lint, formatting, syntax, file-size, package-manager, version, secret and duplication checks passed; all 168 tracked dependency declarations are current.
- [Full local validation and preserved logs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2685-429d60c8a3fc/docs/case-studies/issue-2685/data/local-validation.json).
- [Full implementation CI](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37719356959) passed the default suite, GitHub integration, execution, memory, quality and dependency checks, plus Docker builds and container verification. [Security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37719356693) and [links](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37719356610) also passed.
- [Archived CI metadata and complete logs](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2685-429d60c8a3fc/docs/case-studies/issue-2685/data/ci-code-validation.json) identify the tested implementation SHA and individual job conclusions.
- Final head `4ec5f8d976cb120660d7c7930356b0c5cb6e6dd4` passed [Checks and release](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721874788), [security](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721874579), and [link checking](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/actions/runs/37721874582). The later commits contain evidence and experiment scripts; the runtime, tests and Docker diff is identical to the fully tested implementation.

One patch changeset prepares the release. The strict dependency-freshness check required updating the three Docker Node.js pins and their two regression expectations to 26.11.1.

### Visual verification

Before: the original Telegram result reported success with no issues processed.

![Before: original Telegram completion](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2685-429d60c8a3fc/docs/case-studies/issue-2685/screenshots/first-run.png?raw=true)

After: Playwright render of the production completion formatter showing the no-work warning and preserving session details. This is a formatter preview; no Telegram message was sent.

![After: production completion formatter preview](https://github.com/link-assistant/hive-mind/blob/issue-2685-429d60c8a3fc/docs/case-studies/issue-2685/screenshots/completion-after.png?raw=true)
title: fix(hive): report no-work runs as warnings
